title: Matthew Brown snuck into secret congressional briefing
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Matthew Brown snuck into secret congressional briefing, about 2024-2026 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um I snuck him in, you know, to have a secret congressional briefing with three members who all said yes to me.

plain: A man named Jeremy Corbell, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2026, says he quietly brought a man named Matthew Brown into a secret briefing in Washington, DC, sometime between 2024 and 2026. According to Corbell, three members of Congress had agreed to meet, and he snuck Brown in so Brown could speak to them privately, which would mean lawmakers were hearing UFO claims behind closed doors.
